name: Cacareco Girl
summary: The aesthetic is a direct reaction against the minimalism of the "Quiet Luxury" and " Old Money " trends.
description: The aesthetic is a direct reaction against the minimalism of the "Quiet Luxury" and " Old Money " trends. Instead of clean lines and neutral tones, the Cacareco Girl embraces a vibrant, cluttered, and highly personalized look, using objects as a form of self-expression and identity. [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Maximalism, nostalgia, self-expression, authenticity, emotional comfort, anti-minimalism

visualDNA.colour: Vibrant and eclectic (pinks, greens, reds, blues)

fashion.Overview: The associated fashion style is equally vibrant and eclectic, featuring bold stripes, colorful patterns, and "funky" motifs like sardines. Brazilian brands such as FARM Rio and Mabô Rio are cited as representative of the look. The aesthetic is not about wearing a uniform, but about using a collection of objects to create a unique and personal style.
